scope: Sol's uncommitted member Settings D87 load-ladder acceptance-oracle correction and sanitized run 38051093370

findings.title: Initial rendered-identity check does not receive the load-ladder resolution
evidence: tests/browser/settings-native-auth-driver.mjs: resolveMemberOrganizationSelection computes organizationResolution, then the member_rendered_identity call to verifyCurrentSettingsIdentity passes only selected.organizationId

tests/browser/settings-native-auth-driver.mjs: verifyCurrentSettingsIdentity defaults organizationResolution to undefined, so currentSettingsIdentityMatches compares absent storage against the expected ladder UUID
tests/browser/settings-native-auth-driver.test.mjs: source propagation assertion covers assertExpectedIdentity after Settings reload, but not the immediate sign-in identity boundary
findings.impact: The proposed correction still rejects the intended load_ladder path before signInSettings returns and before any persistence case can run. Thread organizationResolution and the required fixture name through this initial check, then add a forcing test that fails if either argument is omitted.

findings.title: Load-ladder proof does not bind the expected UUID to the live logical organization
evidence: tests/browser/settings-native-auth-driver.mjs: load_ladder acceptance checks UUID syntax, absent matrx.org.active storage, organizationSelected, and the fixed organization label
tests/browser/settings-native-auth-driver.mjs: panelIdentity observes only persisted matrx.org.active; accountIdentity observes the rendered label, not the active-org logical UUID
tests/browser/settings-native-auth-driver.mjs: expectedOrganizationId comes from the private member link fixture and is only syntax-checked in the load-ladder branch
findings.impact: A label can match while the extension's in-memory/request-bound active organization is a different membership. The oracle does not establish that the live logical organization ID equals the fixture ID. Add a read-only observation at the product boundary that exposes the validated logical active-org ID (or an equivalent request header/principal proof), and force a wrong-ID/ correct-label negative to fail.

evidence_assessment.run_observation: Native report failed at baseline/settings_ready with d87_rendered_identity_not_observed; zero persistence cases ran.
evidence_assessment.resource_finals: package and browser valid; guest child_failed exit 1 with resourceInvalid=false. This is a product-oracle child failure, not resource invalidation, but it is not a product defect verdict.
evidence_assessment.artifact_scope: Run used frozen v0.2.464 from CI 38050509032/artifact 11669182890 at source 8d2f8ca2. The reviewed five-file correction is uncommitted local work and was not exercised by this run.
evidence_assessment.sanitized_fixture_limit: The sanitized receipt omits the private fixture's organization UUID/name mapping, so this review verifies the harness's source-level fixture use but cannot independently verify the live fixture membership-to-ID mapping from run artifacts.

verification.limits: Unit tests pass but do not exercise the omitted initial identity arguments or bind the logical active organization ID to the fixture ID. No hosted retest was run.
